title: The form says it saved
summary: The front desk is told 'Appointment added' for bookings that were never saved. You are the Frontend engineer: find out what the page does with the server's answer and fix it everywhere it happens.
goal: The form says it saved at the Hospital OPD
brief:
It is Friday, 08:35. Since the double-bookings fix went live the database refuses a second booking for a slot, and the API says so: 409 and a message. But the front desk reports that the booking form still closes with a green 'Appointment added' for a slot that was taken, and no booking appears. Two patients have already turned up for appointments that do not exist. The morning clinic opens at 09:00.

You are the Frontend engineer on call. Meera's seat is yours. The pages of the Hospital OPD manager are in static/ (the shell, app.js, the styles) and the tests of the pages run in Node from tests/ui. The backend and the database are finished and tested: they are read-only for you, Rohan owns backend/ and helps if you ask. Find out what the page does with the server's answer, fix it everywhere the same mistake is made, and add a regression test. Submit your work: Q runs every test, the Reviewer reads your change, and the Integrator merges it.

The team is in #incident-frontdesk. Ananya (QA) has the steps, Aarav (lead) wants updates. Every question you ask is counted.

task.title: Fix: the pages report a refused request as a success

acks: Thanks for the update. Keep us posted.

evidence.steps: Appointments, + New appointment, doctor Dr. Farhan Ali, date 15 Oct 2026, time 11:00 (already booked for Sana Sheikh, appointment 12), Add appointment
evidence.what_i_see: the dialog closes and a green toast says 'Appointment added'; the table shows no new row and Dr. Farhan Ali's page still lists Sana Sheikh only
evidence.phone: A patient phone with 9 digits (98765 4321) is answered 400 with {"detail": "Patient phone must be a 10-digit mobile number"}, and the page says 'Appointment added' as well
evidence.stale: Cancel on an appointment that another desk had just completed is answered 409 with {"detail": "That status change is not allowed"}, and the page shows the green 'Cancelled' toast

backend.persona: Rohan, backend engineer. Helpful, direct, answers only about backend/ and how the API behaves. He will not change the API: he says it answers correctly and the page must read the answer.
facts: The API answers a refused request with a 4xx status and {"detail": "<message>"}: 409 'Slot already booked' (the database refuses a second Booked row), 400 for a bad phone, 404 when the record is gone, 409 'That status change is not allowed'.
The status code is what tells a client whether a request worked: 2xx is saved, anything else is not.
tests/api/test_double_booking_api.py shows the 409 and its message; backend/main.py turns a database refusal into it.
He did not change anything in backend/ this week, and every backend test passes. The page code is in static/shell.js.

fallbacks.text: The API answers correctly: 409 and {"detail": "Slot already booked"} for a taken slot, 400 with a message for a bad phone, 404 when the record is gone. See tests/api/test_double_booking_api.py. What the page does with that answer is the question.
I will not change the API: it refuses the request and says why, with the right status. Look at how the page reads that answer.

guide.title: Reproduce it
guide.text: Press Run tests and read which tests fail and what each says the page showed. That is your starting point. Post a first update in #incident-frontdesk within 2 minutes, and answer Aarav within a minute when he asks.

guide.title: Read what the server answers
guide.text: The page is shown real answers of the real API. Open tests/api/test_double_booking_api.py (read-only for you) and backend/main.py and see what the server sends back when it refuses a booking: its status and its message.

guide.title: Find the code that sends the requests
guide.text: Every form, button and drag on the page sends its request through one place in static/shell.js. Open it (you can search the project for fetch) and read what it does with an answer that is not a success.

guide.title: Tell the team
guide.text: Post what you found in #incident-frontdesk (Agent Chat tab). Aarav is waiting for an update; you can also ask Rohan or Ananya.

guide.title: Add a regression test
guide.text: Add a regression test in tests/regression/ that fails before your fix: run the page's request code in Node with a stub fetch that answers 409 and expect the request to fail with the server's message. Name the file test_regression_<what>.py and copy the style of tests/ui/test_refusals.py. Run it: it has to be red now and green once the page treats a refused request as an error.

guide.title: Fix it everywhere
guide.text: Change static/shell.js so that a refused request is an error for every form, button and drag, and the server's own message reaches the person. Fix the cause, not one screen.

guide.title: Run the tests again
guide.text: Run tests. The whole suite has to be green, not only the acceptance tests.

guide.title: Submit for review
guide.text: Press Submit for review. The Reviewer reads your change and may send it back up to twice.
